title: SignalBus
description: SignalBus v2.1 — immutable tax-idea signal record shared between T0–T7 agents

signalId.description: UUIDv7 identifier for this signal record

originAgent.description: Agent tier that originated this signal

lawArticle.description: Primary legal article reference (e.g. 조특법 §10 ②2호)

ideaTitle.description: Short human-readable title of the tax idea

citationTokens.description: Ordered list of citation tokens in format {source}:{docType}:{docId}:{date}:{hash8}

readOnlySnapshot.description: Immutability flag — always true; records must never be mutated after creation

recursionDepth.description: How many times this signal has been recursively expanded (max 1)

gateDecisions.description: Ordered list of gate evaluation outcomes

track.description: Processing track assigned at this gate

checkedBy.description: Agent or person who evaluated this gate

deadline.description: Action deadline in ISO 8601 date format

triggerCitationToken.description: Citation token that triggers posterior re-evaluation (required for track 3mo_posterior)

discoveredAt.description: ISO 8601 date-time when this signal was first generated

retrievalQueries.description: Raw retrieval queries used to discover supporting citations

promptVersion.description: Version string of the prompt template that produced this signal

estimatedRefundRange.description: Ballpark refund/saving range in Korean Won

basis.description: Methodology or assumptions underlying the estimate

evidenceChecklist.description: Documents or evidence items required to substantiate the claim

ksicMapping.description: Korean Standard Industrial Classification mapping for target population

codes.description: 5-digit KSIC codes applicable to this idea

estimatedTargets.description: Estimated number of businesses falling within the mapped codes

finalDecision.description: Human reviewer's final disposition of this signal

counterExamples.description: Known counter-examples or adverse rulings that weaken this idea
